content.short: Santiment is a market intelligence platform with on-chain and social metrics for 2,500+ cryptocurrencies.
content.description: Santiment is a cryptocurrency and blockchain–focused financial market data and content platform that aggregates data feeds and content streams, including newswires, and maintains a regularly updated database of cryptocurrency projects. In accordance with FINMA regulations, the Santiment Network Token Prototype (SAN) is issued in Switzerland as a coupon. Users and exchanges can access these information streams and feeds by staking SAN.
